paper_metadata.title: Effect of niobium addition upon microstructure and tensile properties of CrMnFeCoNix high entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Nb-doped CrMnFeCoNix (x = 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1) high entropy alloys were prepared by vacuum induction melting.

Ingots of Nb-doped CrMnFeCoNix high entropy alloys with a weight of about 50 g were prepared via vacuum induction melting of the constituent high-purity elements (> 99.9%) under a high-purity argon atmosphere.
